description:
What this is. A record of an employee leaving the site during working hours: when they went, why, and when they are expected back. Security closes it off when they return.

What to do. Fill in which employee is leaving, when and why. It goes for approval, and the guard at the gate completes it on the way back in. People see their own passes; managers and HR see their team's.

Where to find it. Gate Pass in the menu on the left.
name: Issue a Gate Pass
title: Gate Pass — an employee leaving during work hours
